newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-VAAS TAKES HAT-TRICK IN SRI LANKA WARM-UP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-VAAS TAKES HAT-TRICK IN SRI LANKA WARM-UP.

text.p: Left arm seamer Chaminda Vaas took a hat-trick and claimed six for 22 on Thursday as Sri Lanka started their New Zealand tour with a warm-up match.
The World Cup champions skittled Northern Districts for 116 despite good batting conditions on the first day of the two-day match. The tourists replied with 138 for two at stumps.
Vaas dismissed top scorer Matthew Hart, who made 42, Dion Bennett and Mark Tesar with successive deliveries to wrap up the home team's innings midway through the afternoon session.
But historians will not recall his achievement because the contest is not a first-class fixture and performances are not officially recorded.
Northern were grateful to reach three figures after slumping to 12 for four within the opening 12 overs.

Sri Lanka's only disappointment was the failure of top order batsmen Dulip Samaraweera and Marvan Atapattu. Both departed cheaply to seamer Alex Tait, who had them caught in close on the legside by bat-pad fieldsman Matthew Bell.
Roshan Mahanama and Hashan Tillekaratne steered the tourists to safety with an unbroken third wicket stand of 94, with Mahanama on 73 and his partner on 39.
Sri Lanka face New Zealand in the first test in Dunedin on March 7.
